title: Add Custom Tabs to Member Profile Pages Using JQuery | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Add Custom Tabs to Member Profile Pages Using JQuery Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000095798 This article provides jQuery examples for adding one or more custom tabs to member profile pages. When the page loads, the script appends a new tab to the profile navigation and creates the corresponding tab content. Insert the desired code snippet at the bottom of the SEO Template or in Design Settings → Custom Footer Code . Tip If the custom tab contains more than plain text (such as widgets or dynamic content), using [widget=shortcode] inside the tab content may provide more reliable rendering.
